title: Oregon PUC OKs Pacific Power’s Plan to Shield Customers from Data Center Costs

meta.summary:
The Oregon Public Utility Commission approved tariff revisions that would require new data centers in Pacific Power’s service area to pay the full costs of serving their facilities under a direct contracting and direct assignment approach. 
 The post  Oregon PUC OKs Pacific Power’s Plan to Shield Customers from Data Center Costs  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
